newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London drift off in line with Dow.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London drift off in line with Dow.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were slightly easier across the board, tracking the weaker opening on Wall Street.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 12.49 points at 13,593.42 by 1426 GMT.
"The market has been very dull," said one trader. "We've hardly seen any price changes apart from in recent minutes when Wall Street started going down."
HSBC Holdings was trading at HK$207.6 in London, unchanged from its Hong Kong close.
"Hong Kong Bank is drifting around the close and the rest of the market is a little bit easier," the trader said. "People are a bit nervous about dealing at these high levels."
The Hang Seng index finished 26.57 points higher at 13,605.91 on Wednesday.
Turnover in London remained limited to interest in Hong Kong Bank, dealers said.
